name: Carmen Crespo Díaz - Après le § 20 - Am 16
title: REPORT on the multiannual plan for the fisheries exploiting demersal stocks in the Western Mediterranean Sea
part_text: 20a. Recalls that Article 13 TFEU requires the EU to pay full regard to the welfare requirements of animals as sentient beings when formulating and implementing fisheries policy; calls on the Commission to support research into and the gradual introduction of capture, retrieval, handling, stunning and killing practices that minimise the duration and severity of the suffering of fish and crustaceans;
